sentence: This project studies how small clumps of matter and dark matter in the early universe change when star formation begins.
This project studies how chlorine and fluorine were held in zircon from early Earth, using laboratory experiments and mass spectrometry.
This project builds a research center that combines computer science with social and behavioral sciences to study cyber issues, including law and ethics.
This project studies how molecules on the surface of nanocrystals decide their shape, using atomic force microscopy and force spectroscopy.
This project builds a way to protect private data when large recommendation models keep their tables on cloud servers, using hardware and software together.
This project studies how robots and dogs can communicate with each other and builds models that read a dog's stress and readiness.
This project holds a workshop where researchers define security problems that arise when many autonomous artificial intelligence agents interact.
This project studies how the environmental conditions a species lives in differ between related grasshopper species and what drives those differences.
This project studies how vitamin D controls the speed of development and aging in killifishes, using gene editing to remove one enzyme.
This project builds software tools for exploring and creating interactive displays of data recorded by wearable biosensing devices.
This project builds a curriculum about drone technology and the privacy and security threats that drones can cause.
This project acquires a confocal microscope for taking high-resolution images of cells and of changes in living organisms.
This project builds a wall-climbing robot that inspects storage tanks and other explosive environments while they stay in service.
This project designs an afterschool program where children learn about robot and artificial intelligence ethics through acting, dance, music and drawing.
This project studies how DNA and RNA strands displace one another and builds a tool for designing DNA and RNA sequences.
This project builds a bendable surgical robot that can be tracked and controlled safely while being watched with MRI.
This project builds a statistical tool that tests whether tandem repeats in DNA help great apes adapt.
